title: Field boundaries for Estonia - Eurocrops 2021
description:
Geospatial Aid Application Estonia Agricultural parcels.
The original dataset is provided by ARIB and obtained from the INSPIRE theme GSAA (specifically Geospaial Aid Application Estonia Agricultural parcels) through which the data layer Fields and Eco Areas (GSAA) is made available.
The data comes from ARIB's database of agricultural parcels.

This collection holds 1 edition (2021), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_ee/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2021). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:4326). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_ee/AGENTS.md).

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: viimase_muutmise_aeg
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `viimase_mu`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: taotleja_nimi
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `taotleja_n`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: hcat:name_en
table:columns.description: The original crop name translated into English. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/hcat-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: crop:code
table:columns.description: The crop code, from the code list of the source. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: taotletud_toetus
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `taotletu_2`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: taotleja_registrikood
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `taotleja_r`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: hcat:code
table:columns.description: The 10-digit HCAT code indicating the hierarchy of the crop. The first 4, 6, 8 digits select increasingly specific crop groups. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/hcat-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: hcat:name
table:columns.description: The machine-readable HCAT name of the crop (Hierarchical Crop and Agriculture Taxonomy, EuroCrops). ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/hcat-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: taotletud_maakasutus
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `taotletu_1`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: niitmise_tuvast_ajavahemik
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `niitmise_1`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: niitmise_tuvastamise_staatus
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `niitmise_t`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: Edition year of the source dataset (the converter variant). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: Estonia - Eurocrops 2021 — latest edition (2021) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2021/ec_ee.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-hcat-crops.title: Crops (HCAT)
style-hcat-crops.description: Fields coloured by harmonized crop (EuroCrops HCAT code, `hcat:code`). The 12 crops covering the most area are named, everything else is grey. Colours follow the fiboa.org crop map palette.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 0.5, 2, 5, 10 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.
